findings.expected: Serve a French banner image (e.g. banner-fr.png) on the French page.
findings.description: The French page uses the English banner image, which shows English text ("Financing that fits your plans. Competitive rates. Clear terms. No surprises.").
Footer is in English on the French page, and the brand name differs from the header ("Banque Northstar").
Uses informal "tu" while the hero title and rest of the site use "vous"; inappropriate for a bank.
"Appliquer pour" is an anglicism (calque of "apply for"); in Quebec French use "Faire une demande de prêt" / "Demander un prêt".
Full name validation error is in English on the French page; the other fields are translated.

findings.observed: Merci. Votre demande pour {montant} a été reçue.
findings.expected: Merci. Votre demande pour 12 500,00 $ a été reçue.
findings.description: The confirmation message shows the raw template variable {montant} instead of the formatted amount.
"Balance" is an anglicism for an account balance; correct French is "solde".
A bank "statement" is a "relevé", not a "déclaration" (which suggests a tax or formal declaration); wrong word in context.
In French, zero takes the singular (0 and 1 are singular), so "0 prêts actifs" is wrong.
Table heading left in English on the French dashboard.

Transaction dates use US MM/DD/YYYY order in French (09/15/2026, 09/12/2026, 09/08/2026), ambiguous and not fr-CA convention. Due date also shows raw ISO "2026-10-01" while the application page uses long-form dates.
The "Estimer un nouveau prêt" link on the French dashboard points to the English calculator page.
"Pay later" is translated as "Payer maintenant" (pay now), the opposite meaning, and contradicts the help text about a 30-day deferral.

findings.observed: Aucune accusation pour un remboursement anticipé.
findings.expected: Aucuns frais ne s'appliquent en cas de remboursement anticipé.
Taux variable de 5,2 %, sous réserve de l'approbation du crédit.
findings.description: French drops the condition "subject to credit approval".
Estimated monthly payment uses English currency format on the French page, unlike other amounts (e.g. 12 458,30 $).

findings.expected: Use a French promo image showing "Taux variable : 5,2 %".
findings.description: The French promo image shows a different rate type and value (fixed 4.9%) than the alt text and page text (variable 5.2%).
"Close" translated as the adjective "Proche" (near/close by) instead of the verb "Fermer".
